one_line: Open on the finished gift, then show each part with its price so a viewer can copy it.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 close shot of a finished gift: a jar and a grape-juice bottle in cellophane tied with twine, on a woven mat. No speech, no text yet. 0:01 a white circle sticker appears with handwriting-style text: "פורים" and "מתנות לצוותים".
q1_hook.why: The finished gift fills the frame and tells a parent what the Reel gives (H2), and the sticker at 1 s names the occasion and the task (T3, K7). No face or voice opens it (against H4), and the next 8 s are a slow wide shot (H1).

beats.what: The finished gift in cellophane, jar and juice bottle
beats.why: Shows the result before any work

beats.what: Sticker "פורים / מתנות לצוותים"; a static wide shot, she unpacks shop bags and lines up jars
beats.why: Shows the amount of work, but it is the slowest stretch

beats.what: Jar close-up with its price label
beats.why: First price, and the first close shot

beats.what: Hands fill the jar with stuffed Hamantaschen; label with price
beats.why: A satisfying action with a price

beats.what: Grape-juice bottle in hand, then wide shots lining bottles up; price label
A row of jars and six bottles on the table
beats.why: Shows how many gifts one session makes

beats.what: She designs the card on a laptop, then printed cards "פורים שמח!" in hand
beats.why: Shows the personal touch is her own

beats.what: A ball of twine; a card is tied to a jar; label with price
The finished gift again; from 0:35 a circle text asks viewers to write to her
beats.why: Closes on the opening shot with an offer

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen 0:35-0:37: a circle text asking to write to her to get the card for the gan staff. The caption has no question or ask.
q2_flow.why: Result, parts, assembly, result is a clear arc, and a new item with a price every few seconds keeps it moving (K2, R3). Ending on the opening shot loops back (R4). The 8 s wide unpacking is the slowest part and shows no product detail (R1, R3). A gift idea parents could send to other parents (R5).

q3_cta.what: On screen 0:35-0:37, a circle text read from the frame: "אם בא לך את הברכה גם לצוות בגן של ילדייך תכתבי לי". Nothing said. The caption has no ask.
q3_cta.why: A specific offer, the greeting card, aimed at a named recipient, the gan staff, is a real reason to write (C2, R6). But "תכתבי לי" gives no keyword and no place, it is up for 3 s, and the caption does not repeat it (against C6).

q4_shown.what: The finished gift 0:00-0:01 and 0:33-0:37; the creator unpacking shop bags 0:02-0:09; each item with its shekel price 0:10-0:20 and 0:30-0:32; jars and six bottles in a row 0:21-0:22; designing and printing the card 0:23-0:28; tying it on 0:29-0:32.
q4_shown.why: Result first, then every part with its shekel price, lets a viewer copy the gift and see it is cheap (H2, K4). Prices are per item, with no total for one gift (S3). The shop's bags and juice label are props in frame for a good part of the Reel (C7). No recipient reaction (K8).

q5_edit.what: About 16 shots in 37 s (about 2.3 s each), straight cuts, alternating a static tripod wide shot with handheld close-ups. The wide unpacking 0:02-0:09 is one long shot. Price labels per item; circle stickers 0:01-0:04 and 0:35-0:37. No speech. Ends on the opening shot.
q5_edit.why: Wide and close shots alternate with a new item every few seconds (E2, R3). The 8 s wide opening is the slowest part (R1). Ending on the opening gift loops back (R4, E8). With no speech, labels carry everything, so it works muted (T1), though nothing audible adds (E4).

q6_topic.what: A cheap do-it-yourself Purim gift for gan staff with every part priced; it serves parents who must give staff gifts and want a quick, good-looking one.
q6_topic.why: A dated gifting moment with a clear buyer, the parent, and an itemised list that is easy to save and to send to other parents on the class committee (K7, R5, R7). The mood is practical, with little emotion (K1).

q7_filmed.what: A static close shot of the finished gift on a woven mat; a static wide tripod shot in a bright dining area, the creator in a grey dress; handheld close-ups of hands with jars, a bottle, cards and twine; a top-down laptop shot. Window light.
q7_filmed.why: A real home, a real person and daylight give a creator look (H8, F7). Close-ups are readable at phone size (F4, F5), but the wide tripod shot makes the items small (F4). Thin price text over a busy room is hard to read at 0:10 (T5).

q8_text.on_screen: 0:01-0:04 white circle sticker, handwriting style, top-left, about 10 to 30 percent down: "פורים", "מתנות לצוותים". Thin white price labels, centred, about 66 to 85 percent down: "צנצנת זכוכית" with "קטנה 3 ב-10.90 ש"ח" (0:10-0:12), "אוזני המן ממולאים" with "10.90 ש"ח" (0:13-0:15), "תירוש אדום 187 מ"ל" with "2 ב-10.90 ש"ח" (0:17-0:19), "חבל יוטה 2.90 ש"ח" (0:30-0:31). 0:35-0:37 circle: "אם בא לך את הברכה גם לצוות בגן של ילדייך תכתבי לי".
q8_text.caption: "מתנות צוות לפורים❤️". 11 words in 2 lines: the title, then "רק ב@max_stock_israel"; 5 hashtags (#וועד #diy #פורים #מתנה #צוות). No ask or question; the store tag is the only sign of a commercial link and has no disclosure words.
q8_text.why: The sticker names occasion and buyer within a second (T3, K7), and every price is in text, so it works muted (T1). Price text is thin and sits low over a busy room (T2, T4). The caption has occasion keywords and 5 hashtags but no ask (T7); a store tag is not a disclosure (T8).

weak_points: An 8 s wide unpacking shot up front; thin price text over a busy room; a vague "write to me" ask for 3 s and none in the caption; an undisclosed store tag; no voice or recipient reaction.
lumebook_takeaway: Open on the finished wrapped book, then show each part (cover, dedication, wrapping) with its price. End on the book with one clear comment word.
not_verified: Audio: the transcript has only "אהה" and "אה" artifacts, so there is no speech; music or other sound cannot be told. Whether the store is a paid partner (caption tag, label 0). What writing to her delivers. Whether the 0:02-0:09 shot is sped up. Corrections: her face is visible in the wide shot, facing the lens at 0:09, so it is not hands only; there is no text in the very first frame, the sticker appears at 0:01; the closing circle text runs 0:35-0:37.
